content.short: Jellyverse is a Balancer-forked DeFi ecosystem on Sei featuring synthetic assets and advanced liquidity pools.
content.description: Jellyverse is a comprehensive DeFi ecosystem built on the Sei Network, serving as an official fork of the Balancer protocol. The platform brings sophisticated liquidity management to Sei through JellySwap, which supports weighted and stable pools. By allowing users to create pools with up to eight different tokens, Jellyverse provides unparalleled flexibility for liquidity providers. Beyond AMM capabilities, it features jAssets, a synthetic assets protocol for trading real-world mirrors like stocks and commodities, all secured by a decentralized governance model via JellyStake.
content.meta: Jellyverse provides Balancer-style liquidity pools and synthetic real-world assets on Sei. Discover Jellyverse and other DeFi Dapps on Lancers.
